latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert static images into animated MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.

- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, and GIF files up to 200MB.
- Automated setup: free token generation and session establishment for easy out-of-the-box use.
- Export 1080p MP4 videos; typical processing takes 30-60 seconds.
- Designed for marketers and social media creators needing quick image-to-video workflows.
- Simple commands for upload, export, credits balance, and project status.
- Error handling and helpful guidance for file types, credits, and export issues.
